description: Derive Solana program-derived addresses offline: findProgramAddress (canonical bump search) for any program and typed seeds (utf8, base58 pubkey, hex, u8/u16/u32/u64 little- or big-endian), or the associated token account (ATA) of an owner + mint for SPL Token or Token-2022. Same algorithm as @solana/web3.js (sha256 + ed25519 off-curve check). Useful to locate token accounts, Anchor PDAs and vaults without an RPC. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/sol-pda

bump.description: custom: use this bump (createProgramAddress) instead of searching

owner.description: ata: wallet that owns the token account

preset.description: ata = associated token account of owner + mint; custom = programId + seeds

seeds.description: custom: seeds as "utf8:vault", "pubkey:<base58>", "hex:0a0b", "u8:1", "u64:42", "u32be:7" (no prefix: a 32-byte base58 string is a pubkey, else utf8); JSON array if a seed contains commas

name: sol_pda
title: Sol Pda
